conditions.human_role: Identified the panel and supplied the 2025 study.

solution.what: Located the revised KMD 30 edition based on clearer photographs.
Compared KMD 31 sign 3 with KMD 28 sign 4, KMG 10 and KMD 191. The comparisons support a provisional ṣ if Script 1a values apply.
Tested whether alphabetic wraparound distinguishes the missing sign. Three candidates require the same two omissions.
